status: independently reviewed and accepted within the stated bound
engine_basis: Zend/zend_object_handlers.c::zend_std_compare_objects scans the seven declared physical slots of distinct same-class builtin objects in order and recurses through the previous object slot; identical object identities compare equal.

Zend/zend_operators.c::zend_compare returns -1 for null/object and +1 for object/null before dispatching object/object pairs. Zend/zend_exceptions.c::Exception::__construct stores the supplied previous Throwable in that physical slot.
scope: Normal nonpending comparison of distinct, live, canonical, unmaterialized same-kind builtin Exception/Exception or Error/Error roots with at least one nonnull previous link. Every node in each previous chain has the root's exact builtin kind, a physical empty PSTRING cache, an allocated empty trace, no freeing state and valid seven-slot image. Each chain is acyclic and has at most 16 nodes. The first six slots compare before the previous slot; null/object, shared identity and distinct recursive links are handled explicitly. This is a conservative admission cap, not Zend's precise stack threshold. Direct and equal-prefix array comparisons use the same order.

implementation.rule: A path-local 16-node chain validator authenticates every reached object before reading its previous link. The new pair guard requires a positive root previous witness, preserving disjointness from COMP129-133. A dedicated pure comparator scans the first six physical slots, then compares the previous links by null/object sign, identity or recursion. The old Throwable Unsupported rule excludes exactly this admitted pair; no earlier predicate was changed.
